verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own Business & Liens portal lists online filing for new businesses, amendments, annual renewals and reinstatements. Payment runs through US Bank, and an Online Account keeps a transaction history of completed filings, so the core form-and-file transaction can be finished online. Missing for 10: detailed first-party walkthrough of the online formation flow (fees, steps, turnaround), independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed online filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: File: New Business, Amendment, Annual Renewal or Reinstatement
Multiple filings on multiple entities can be processed thru one Online Account.
An Online Account will maintain a Transaction History with links to view and print your completed filings for up to 90 days.
The US Bank website allows you to pay without registering with them by clicking on “Pay without Registering”.
